evidence.P1: Four of the five chains hold genuine condition rather than sequence — e.g. The Reluctant One moves from ev-032's denial ('wager on a man') into ev-038's chosen stand, which is a real turn rather than a next-step; but The Red Pill breaks at ev-020, where Cypher's bargain is caused by 'the unbearable cost of the truth (and the death-prophecy he carries)' — the death-prophecy belongs to ev-023, an event this plot skips, so the stated cause lands outside the chain's own links.
evidence.P2: The Wager and The Reluctant One both stake themselves on the identical ev-039→ev-045 movement ('refuses the name and fate Smith pronounces' → 'fulfills the prophecy only by refusing to be bound by it'), so the dilemma is argued from the same scenes rather than from a distinct stance; the theme statements themselves ('Identity — Who am I?' vs 'Freedom vs. determinism') blur into one another at the refusal apex.
evidence.P3: The Body Count earns ev-005, ev-020, ev-023, ev-025, ev-026, ev-032 cleanly — each is the literal 'body count' or its counter — but ev-029 (Cypher's actual murders of Apoc, Switch, and Dozer) is the plot's namesake event and is omitted, leaving the stated 'body count' carried by Morpheus's capture rather than the betrayal killings that produce it.
evidence.P4: The Reluctant One has a full arc — imposed label (ev-008), refusal (ev-013, ev-032), suspension (ev-016, ev-023), turn (ev-038), and self-authored coda (ev-045, ev-047) — but The Red Pill stops at ev-020 with the promise of 'a living test of whether anyone will hold onto it,' and that test (Cypher's betrayal, his death, or Neo's contrasting commitment) is never delivered as a resolving link.
evidence.P5: The Rescue and The Wager both build to ev-032 as their 'central' act and both resolve at ev-039→ev-045, and The Body Count also terminates at ev-032 ('buys in through sacrifice, the mirror of Cypher selling out'), so three plots converge on the same pivot event and the same refusal-and-return resolution rather than partitioning the material.

commentary: The layer reads the film's event strata accurately and anchors every claim in named events, but it over-partitions a single identity/faith arc into five plots that share their spine. The strongest, cleanest chain is The Reluctant One, whose links carry real causal turns and a completed arc; the weakest is The Red Pill, whose stated 'living test' is promised in the definition and never chained, and whose one non-first causal link reaches outside its own membership. The three plots that funnel through ev-032 and ev-039→ev-045 are doing rehash work: they are facets of one dilemma, not five plots, and P5 is where the layer most clearly over-claims.
